meta.source: Sentinel-2 L2A COGs via the Element84 Earth Search STAC (https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1, collection sentinel-2-l2a); windowed ranged COG reads over the site AOI only, no full-tile downloads

aoi.alpha_beach_south: extra AOI for alpha-beach-156 over the south-end cleared area: the southern 600 m of the mapped drain LineString, measured along the line from the southern (lowest-latitude) endpoint, buffered 250 m (UTM 31N)

step_method.description: best two-segment piecewise-constant fit on the monthly series of each index; step month = first month of the second segment; the stronger of vegfrac/BSI is reported

indices.vegfrac: fraction of clear AOI pixels with NDVI > 0.4
indices.aggregation: per-scene medians/fractions over clear AOI pixels, then monthly medians with scene counts

meta.reflectance: DN/10000; the -1000 BOA offset is subtracted for processing baseline >= 04.00 unless earthsearch:boa_offset_applied is true (already applied by the provider)
caveats: 10-20 m pixels cannot show drains; steps date site-scale vegetation clearing, sand-filling, earthworks and new roofs, not the drain itself.
Monthly medians damp short-lived events (e.g. the 4 Aug 2025 Ikorodu cofferdam, likely gone within days).
The two-segment constant fit does not model the seasonal cycle; candidate steps that fail the improvement/t/size thresholds are reported as no clear change rather than discarded silently.
SCL misclassification over dense urban or dark surfaces can bias the indices; scenes need >= 70% clear AOI pixels to be kept.

alpha-beach-156__south.label: southern 600 m of the drain line (from the southern endpoint), buffered 250 m
